test_CholmodSparseSolver: test the CholmodSparseSolver by solving a sparse linear system with damping and verifying correctness
build_sparse_matrix: build a sparse matrix in CSR format with random data for a given batch size
create_CholmodSparseSolver: create a CholmodSparseSolver with an Objective, VariableOrdering, and damping parameter
run_sparse_solver_solve: run the solver to solve the linear system and return the solution vector
review_sparse_solver_correctness: review the sparse solver correctness by checking AtA x + damping x equals Atb
